title: Channel-projection-aware INT8 conversion pipeline and runtime adapter
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Implement a channel-projection-aware INT8 calibration and runtime adapter that provides SmoothQuant-like activation balancing without requiring invasive model surgery. The feature will produce per-channel projection/rescale profiles during calibration, expose a compact profile format that the runtime can apply at inference time, and provide a fallback path to token-level compensated kernels when numerical drift is detected.

Scope:
- Calibration CLI changes to collect and persist channel-projection matrices and per-channel scale factors alongside existing per-tensor histograms.
- A lightweight "profile" artifact format (JSON+binary blobs) and a loader in the runtime that can apply projection/rescale either as a one-time fused pre-activation transform or as on-the-fly kernel adjustments.
- Kernel adapter in the runtime to accept a projection matrix / rescale vector and route execution to optimized fused operators on common hardware (A100/H100/RTX) or a slower fallback path that applies per-channel compensation in microkernels.
- E2E validation harness: golden prompt corpus, calibration dataset sampling guidance, automated regression checks (WER/EM/embedding drift thresholds) and perf cost analysis measured by token latency and GPU utilization.

Success metrics:
- Accuracy regression vs FP32 within target thresholds: median embedding cosine > 0.995 and generation EM/WER degradation < 0.8% across validation set.
- Latency uplift <= 7% with fused adapter on A100 for typical small-batch interactive workloads.
- Calibration artifact size < 3x model param size overhead for common LLMs (7B-70B).
- Rollout gating: automated canary with rollback trigger on accuracy drift or tail latency > SLA.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration CLI produces channel-projection profile artifact with schema docs and example for 7B/13B models
Runtime can load profile and run fused projection+quantized matmul kernel on A100/H100 for at least two model families (LLama-like and MPT-like)
Fallback microkernel executed when profile incompatible; correctness verified against FP32 baseline within defined thresholds
CI regression test that runs calibration->deploy->validation on a small golden corpus and fails if accuracy or latency gates are violated
Documentation: Confluence spec, SDK/CLI flag docs, and migration notes for Dedicated/Private customers
steps: Design & spec: finalize profile schema and loading semantics (owner: Marco)

Runtime adapter: add profile loader and fused kernel dispatch path (owner: Marco)
Microkernel fallback: implement compensated execution for unsupported hardware (owner: Priya Rao)
Validation: run golden-corpus accuracy checks and perf benchmarks across hw targets (owner: SRE/Bench)
CI gating: add regression to nightly and add rollout canary checks in Console
comments: 2025-02-13 - Aisha: Initial spike completed. Calibration harness can now extract per-channel activation statistics and compute a projection matrix using SVD-based minimization. Prototype profile written to /tmp/profile.{json,bin}.

2025-02-18 - Marco: Design review notes: prefer compact row-major binary for matrix blob, include version field and model-hash. Decided to support both fused one-shot transform and on-the-fly kernel rescale modes.
2025-02-21 - Priya Rao: Microkernel sketch implemented in bench harness. Fallback path correct but ~3x slower; acceptable as emergency rollback only.

2025-02-25 - QA: Baseline runs vs FP32 show median embedding cosine 0.996 for 7B test model after projection+int8 quant. Edge-cases with layernorm-adjacent activations need a small bias clamp - adding to backlog.

2025-03-01 - Marco: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1843 with profile loader and dispatch plumbing. Requesting review from @danielle and @priya. See Confluence spec: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/Channel+ Projection+Profile+Spec

2025-03-03 - Aisha: Added CI job that runs the calibration->deploy->validate pipeline on small sample. Observed tail latency increase on small-batch H100 path; investigating kernel launch overhead and batching strategy.
notes: Profile format must be backwards compatible with older runtimes; include graceful no-op loader.
Consider tradeoffs for profile caching in Dedicated clusters with shared GPUs and multiple tenants.
We should add an SDK helper to introspect and visualize applied per-channel scales for debugging customer regressions.
